body:
I took @roookeee's 2 PRs and played a little bit with it (branch https://github.com/warappa/godot/tree/experiments/functionpointer). It's messy, but I already see some performance improvements (based on master 4.7.0-dev):

### Release and Debug build of Godot.NET.Sdk and GodotSharp)
Disclaimer: Eye-FPS-counter "rounding measurement" 😉

| Build |No Script 100 | Script 100 | Performance |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Release | ~2300FPS | ~2200FPS | -4% |
| Debug | ~2200FPS | ~2080FPS | -5% |

| Build |No Script 10000 | Script 10000 | Performance |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Release | ~840FPS | ~440FPS | -48% |
| Debug | ~840FPS | ~280FPS | -66% |

### For Comparison 4.6 Numbers
| Build |No Script 100 | Script 100 | Performance | Performance Branch (see above) |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Release (? The shipped version) | ~2200FPS | ~1400FPS | -36% | -4% 🏆 |

| Build |No Script 10000 | Script 10000 | Performance | Performance Branch (see above) |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Release (? The shipped version) | ~840FPS | ~22FPS | -98% | -48% 🏆 |

## EDIT
I adapted your sample to actually to disable VSync and include an empty `Process(double delta)`, otherwise there would be no real overhead and therefore not a real-world scenario.
And: `<AllowUnsafeBlocks>enabled</AllowUnsafeBlocks>` is needed in `.csproj` now.

Bonus: The frametime-spikes are greatly reduced (seen with addon "Debug Menu")! 📈
Close this issue as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116300 is merged.
